observations.body: The voice of one who calls out, Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: A voice calls for a way and highway in wilderness and desert.
observations.label: A way prepared

observations.body: The wilderness is reshaped for the LORD’s coming through lowered and raised ground.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 40:1–5 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The command names preparation before it describes how the whole vision will occur.
payload.title: A voice prepares a way
